title: Spectral and Isoperimetric Bounds on Flat Tori
summary: We record several elementary relations between spectral and isoperimetric parameters of a flat torus $\mathbb{T}_Λ= \mathbb{R}^n/Λ$ and the covariance structure of a fundamental domain $K$ for the lattice $Λ\subset \mathbb{R}^n$.
